project_type: Next.js 16.4.2 App Router (src/app/(app)/) + Supabase + TypeScript monorepo
build_system: Next.js 16 with Turbopack; scripts in package.json: build, lint, test
test_framework: vitest (src/lib/cache/*.test.ts pattern); test runner: npx vitest run
verification_instructions: After all changes: cd /Users/Apple/code/clients/kazi && npx tsc --noEmit — must exit 0 with no errors.
environment_constraints: Do NOT start dev server. Do NOT push branches. Do NOT apply migrations (already handled separately). Working directory is /Users/Apple/code/clients/kazi.
contribution_requirements: Every new DB table: enable RLS, GRANT ALL TO service_role, CREATE POLICY denying anon. Server components are async functions; client components need 'use client'. API routes use supabaseAdmin for DB, getServerSession for auth. Icons: @iconify/react Icon with solar:*-broken pattern. CSS: Tailwind only. Design tokens: var(--surface), var(--surface-2), var(--border), var(--text-hi), var(--text-lo), brand-500/600.
key_patterns: API routes: import supabaseAdmin from @/lib/supabase, getServerSession from next-auth, authOptions from @/lib/auth, can() from @/lib/rbac. Client components: useState, useRouter from next/navigation. Settings pages: page.tsx exports a server component, client components in src/features/settings/components/. Migrations: pure SQL files in supabase/migrations/. DB types: add to Database interface in src/types/database.ts plus Row/Insert/Update aliases at bottom. Nav: add to sidebarNavGroups in src/lib/nav.ts. Settings nav: add to SETTINGS_NAV in src/features/settings/components/SettingsShell.tsx.
directory_structure: src/app/(app)/ — Next.js App Router pages; src/features/ — feature-scoped components/actions; src/lib/ — shared utilities (rbac, nav, auth, supabase, cache); src/components/ui/ — shared UI components; src/types/database.ts — full Supabase schema types; supabase/migrations/ — plain SQL migration files numbered sequentially
